Jarrett Walker, PhD, is an international consultant in public transit network design and policy. He has been a full-time consultant since 1991 and has led numerous major planning projects in North America, Australia, and New Zealand. He is President at Jarrett Walker + Associates, based in Portland, Oregon, and Principal Consultant with MRCagney in Australia. He writes a blog by the same name (Human Transit).

Taras Hryhoruk

##### 5.0 out of 5 stars Best book in Public Transportation

Reviewed in Germany on September 2, 2024

Verified Purchase

"Human Transit" is the definitive guide for anyone looking to understand the intricacies of public transport and the trade-offs involved in its design and operation. With its clear, structured explanations and minimalist illustrations, the book makes complex concepts accessible and provides invaluable insights into various real-world scenarios. It's an essential read for decision-makers in the public transport sector. Whether you're just starting out or simply looking to deepen your understanding of public transport fundamentals, "Human Transit" is my top recommendation.

##### 5.0 out of 5 stars A must-read for anyone working in public transit or town planning!

Reviewed in Australia on October 17, 2024

Verified Purchase

This book really got me thinking about the transit in my city and how it could better serve the needs of the travelling public. Walker cleverly shows how certain choices lead to particular outcomes for our transit networks, and that competing priorities can result in piecemeal solutions that don't work for anyone. His argument on the geometry of our cities and transit is compelling and thus this book is widely relevant across planning, engineering and operations disciplines.
